# Dyad

Dyad is a local, open-source AI app builder. It's fast, private, and fully under your control — like Lovable, v0, or Bolt, but running right on your machine.

[![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f6c83dfc-6ffd-4d32-93dd-4b9c46d17790)](https://dyad.sh/)

More info at: [https://dyad.sh/](https://dyad.sh/)

## 🚀 Features

- ⚡️ **Local**: Fast, private and no lock-in.
- 🛠 **Bring your own keys**: Use your own AI API keys — no vendor lock-in.
- 🖥️ **Cross-platform**: Easy to run on Mac or Windows.

## 📦 Download

No sign-up required. Just download and go.

### [👉 Download for your platform](https://www.dyad.sh/#download)

## 🤝 Community

Join our growing community of AI app builders on **Reddit**: [r/dyadbuilders](https://www.reddit.com/r/dyadbuilders/) - share your projects and get help from the community!

## 🛠️ Contributing

**Dyad** is open-source (see License info below).

If you're interested in contributing to dyad, please read our [contributing](./CONTRIBUTING.md) doc.

## License

- All the code in this repo outside of `src/pro` is open-source and licensed under Apache 2.0 - see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).
- All the code in this repo within `src/pro` is fair-source and licensed under [Functional Source License 1.1 Apache 2.0](https://fsl.software/) - see [LICENSE](./src/pro/LICENSE).

pkg.name: dyad
pkg.description: Free, local, open-source AI app builder

scripts.package: npm run rebuild:keychain-reader && npm run clean && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run rebuild:keychain-reader && npm run clean && electron-forge make
scripts.publish: npm run rebuild:keychain-reader && npm run clean && electron-forge publish
scripts.ts: npm run ts:main && npm run ts:workers
scripts.ts:workers: npm run ts:workers:code-explorer && npm run ts:workers:supabase-dependency-analysis
scripts.presubmit: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint
scripts.test: node --test scripts/pnpm-install-retry.test.mjs scripts/prepare-safe-storage-baseline.test.mjs scripts/promote-previous-beta.test.mjs scripts/start-supervisor.test.mjs scripts/copy-data-to-dev.test.mjs scripts/unauthorized-release-alert.test.mjs scripts/pr-review/validate-review.test.mjs scripts/pr-review/authorize-review-comment.test.mjs scripts/pr-review/review-tool-guard.test.mjs scripts/issue-triage/triage-comment.test.mjs scripts/issue-triage/prepare-context.test.mjs && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation VITE_CJS_IGNORE_WARNING=true vitest run
